_comment: The burn assessment. This is a HUMAN act, not a computed value, which is why
it lives in a reviewed file in git rather than as a literal inside snapshot.mjs.
A refresh reads the chain and can say what supply and the treasury are RIGHT NOW.
It cannot say whether a burn was a JIP-38 burn — that needs attribution, and
attribution needs a person. So the refresh never advances this file. It compares
the chain against the anchor below and, if anything material has moved, marks the
published assessment 'review-required' instead of restamping it as freshly true.
To advance the assessment: re-do the attribution work, then update assessedAt,
burnedRaw, basis and the anchor together, in one reviewed commit.
assessedBy: exhaustive account enumeration — see FINDINGS.md section 9
basis: The DAO treasury's JTO token account 2Ch9AWnbAaummLkWTTtNgTAvrFq8YMATUaaN77TB2Y6C has been enumerated in full — every one of its 16,821 transactions resolved, none skipped, none unresolved — and contains no burn instruction. Across 77 accounts enumerated in full and 63,063 recorded events, the ledger holds zero burns of any size. The treasury's JTO balance has risen monotonically across every exact reading taken. So no JIP-38 burn has been executed from the DAO's JTO holdings. This supersedes the 2026-09-10 assessment, which rested on the supply invariant plus Jito's own statement.

coverage.method: exhaustive per-account transaction enumeration, reconciled against the supply invariant
establishes: The DAO treasury's JTO token account holds no burn instruction across its entire 16,821-transaction history.
Zero burn instructions appear anywhere in 63,063 events across 77 fully enumerated accounts.
The treasury's JTO balance is monotonically rising in exact base units, so nothing is leaving it.
Genesis was a single mint of exactly 1,000,000,000.000000000 JTO, confirmed as one event.
Every expected read was resolved: zero accounts left incomplete, zero unresolved signatures.
doesNotEstablish: Three accounts exceed 60,000 transactions and were NOT enumerated: the JTX fee program, the DAO treasury wallet, and 8Xm3tkQH581s3MoRHWUNYA5jKbgPATW4tJAAxgwDC6T6.
13,477,314.113606042 JTO has left supply without appearing in this ledger. It predates activation by the fee-revenue argument, but its individual burn transactions have not been located.
A burn executed from an account this crawl never reached.
That JTX fees are being swept into JTO at all — the buyback step remains untraced.
The 80/20 split and the reported fee total, which remain operator claims.

anchor._comment: The chain state this assessment was made against. Movement away from it is what triggers review.
anchor.precisionNote: exact base units, read at the slot above

reviewTriggers._comment: Any of these makes the published assessment 'review-required'.
